resources.string: A floating UP / DOWN / DNT signal checker for Binance.US spot markets. It reads public candles and never places trades.

The 1-hour chart sets the main trend, the 15-minute chart checks momentum, and the 5-minute chart requires strict entry confirmation. Each chart has its own expandable direction and point breakdown. DNT means the signal is neutral, weak, conflicting, or not connected. Public market data does not need an API key. This app is a manual decision aid, not financial advice or an automatic trader.
